text.hi: आज की कहानी: ‘A School Notice’ (स्कूल की सूचना)। पहले कुछ शब्द सीखते हैं।
text.hinglish: Aaj ki kahani: ‘A School Notice’ (School ki soochna). Pehle kuch shabd seekhte hain.
text.en: Today's story: ‘A School Notice’. First, a few words.

text.hi: ‘notice’ मतलब सूचना। छूकर सुनो, फिर बोलो।
text.hinglish: ‘notice’ matlab soochna. Chhookar suno, phir bolo.
text.en: ‘notice’ means सूचना. Tap to listen, then say it.

text.hi: ‘uniform’ मतलब यूनिफ़ॉर्म। छूकर सुनो, फिर बोलो।
text.hinglish: ‘uniform’ matlab uniform. Chhookar suno, phir bolo.
text.en: ‘uniform’ means यूनिफ़ॉर्म. Tap to listen, then say it.

text.hi: ‘welcome’ मतलब स्वागत। छूकर सुनो, फिर बोलो।
text.hinglish: ‘welcome’ matlab swaagat. Chhookar suno, phir bolo.
text.en: ‘welcome’ means स्वागत. Tap to listen, then say it.

sentences: Notice: The annual sports day will be held on Friday next week.
All students must come in their sports uniform.
The school gate will open at eight in the morning.
Please bring a water bottle and a cap.
Lunch will not be served at school.
The school bus will leave at one in the afternoon.

question.en: On which day is the sports day?

question.hi: बच्चों को क्या पहनकर आना है?
question.hinglish: Bachchon ko kya pehenkar aana hai?
